scope: Final independent method audit requested by the coordinator

wording_clarified: wave/generation is an earliest FIFO queue-discovery label under sequential sticky-queue clearing, not a synchronous wave or physical time
period waiting is the difference between event-detection period indices
time-step waiting is the difference in cumulative executed credit-attempt steps at event-detection period ends
lag-1 is pooled adjacent-avalanche-event correlation within runs, not adjacent-period correlation or a mean of per-run correlations
quartile size/duration/branching/credit statistics are pooled event means; quartile occupancy uses pooled period denominators

long_run_design_audit.post_burn_in: remove each run's first 25% of periods

interpretation_boundary.generation: algorithmic earliest FIFO queue-discovery generation; baseline queue membership is sticky and clearing is sequential
interpretation_boundary.waiting: between-event model-clock separation, not within-avalanche duration
interpretation_boundary.occupancy: event periods divided by pooled observed periods; valid because period_end records at most one event per period
interpretation_boundary.lag1: pooled Pearson correlation of adjacent avalanche-event sizes within runs; pairs do not cross runs and need not be adjacent periods
interpretation_boundary.quartile: pooled event means and pooled period occupancy; a drift diagnostic, not a formal stationarity test

audit_procedure.resolver: Generate accounting-consistent random exposure/cash states, run baseline resolve_cascade and resolve_cascade_waves on copies, and compare default sets plus final exposure/assets/debt/cash arrays.
audit_procedure.full_run: Run baseline and dynamics simulations with identical seeds and compare all shared run/event fields under fixed/income and continue/stop protocols.
audit_procedure.temporal_metrics: Reconstruct adjacent-event waits, pooled occupancy, pooled within-run event-lag1 pairs, run-relative quartile labels, burn-in labels, denominators, and every time-window aggregate directly from run_summary.csv and avalanche_events.csv.
